summary: Dispatch worker property-change hooks with a snapshot after synchronous property settlement.
diagnosis: defsRegistry intentionally invokes native property handlers before writing, to allow synchronous replacement/rejection and bound-widget synchronization. The old host bridge snapshotted during that phase. Actual Label63114 reread the old snapshot and submitted an accepted bitmap for the prior property; a later RPC reply refreshed cache without redrawing.
correction: A shared host _sendNodeHook helper preserves synchronous dispatch for every other lifecycle hook. Property-change notifications alone are queued to a microtask and take their snapshot after native settlement completes. Deleted nodes and changed graph/document scopes cancel queued property notifications. The frontend registry and its synchronous setValue/reject behavior are unchanged.

semantics.native_settlement: Executed actual production LGraphNode.setProperty and defsRegistry; bound-widget replacement/rejection synchronization remains intact.
semantics.surface_lifecycle: Property redraws retain one surface, close superseded bitmaps and dispose the final surface/bitmap on removal.
